scope: Independent development replay; no new population or confirmation claim

family.null_rule: Keep all fixed recovery pair slots null when either arm lacks an eligible completed fresh attack
family.release_resampling: One coupled three-draw tuple per seed and bootstrap replicate, shared across all arms and views

replay_units.frozen_attack_auc: At most 40 release units; one per completed eligible fixed slot
replay_units.recovery_and_selection: One aggregate unit after all fixed slots are accounted
replay_units.utility_intervals: One independent aggregate after all 16 INNER utility vector sources
replay_units.refit: At most 6 units: realization zero, pair view, two seeds each for P0, the FIT-nominated new policy, and the strongest eligible control; exact aliases count once

refit_contract.training_role: ATTACK_FIT_NEW, inherited fixed SHA group train subset only
refit_contract.scoring_role: INNER_SELECTION after frozen R4 reader custody checks
refit_contract.common_reader: HGB learning_rate=.05, max_leaf_nodes=15, max_iter=200, early_stopping=False, R4 attacker seed; require prediction parity
refit_contract.stronger_diagnostic: HGB learning_rate=.05, max_leaf_nodes=31, max_iter=300, early_stopping=False, random_state=20261010+source_seed
refit_contract.selection: No best draw, best seed, or refit configuration selection; the refits are a bounded post-selection diagnostic

access.ATTACK_FIT_NEW_SEX: Refit units only, after exact verification seal
access.INNER_SELECTION_SEX: AUC replay and refit units only, after frozen public attack/readers/controls source checks

queue.prerequisite: R0 registers dated exact-source verification amendment and queue admits specs before any numerical replay
